summary: Linearly searches a 104-element dword array beginning at this+3974 (this+0x3E18) for a value equal to a2. Returns the 0-based index of the first matching element, or 63 when the scan exhausts 104 elements without a match.

operations.description: result = 0; match index initialized before the loop.
Iterate cursor i over dword array elements starting at this + 3974 (byte offset 0x3E18), comparing a2 against each element.
If the incremented match index reaches 104 without a match, return 63 (not found sentinel).
Return result (the 0-based index) when the current array element equals a2.

unresolved: Failure sentinel 63 is not 104 or -1; the meaning of 63 to the caller is unknown.
